sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate now preserves the required ship target and method constraint, enforces PC6/PC7, and correctly encodes applicability as the conjunction of the polar-class condition with an alternative for the vertical-sided-bow condition or the 0–10 DEG normal-frame-angle envelope. The angle branch requires evidence and constrains every supplied quantity value; the two boolean representations are not conjunctively mandatory. Deterministic validation is valid.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the applicability alternative: the vertical-sided-bow branch incorrectly requires both verticalSidedBowForm=true and bowVerticalSideStatus=true, duplicating the same condition and causing an accidental overconstraint. Encode the verified condition as PC6/PC7 AND (the canonical vertical-sided-bow condition OR the normalFrameAngle envelope), with the angle alternative requiring every considered normalFrameAngle quantity to be 0–10 DEG. Retain the declared ship-owned terms and method constraint, but do not make two synonymous boolean representations conjunctively mandatory.

The candidate now preserves the required ship target and method constraint, enforces PC6/PC7, and correctly encodes applicability as the conjunction of the polar-class condition with an alternative for the vertical-sided-bow condition or the 0–10 DEG normal-frame-angle envelope. The angle branch requires evidence and constrains every supplied quantity value; the two boolean representations are not conjunctively mandatory. Deterministic validation is valid.
